(A) 6
(B) 7
(C) 8
(D) 9
(E) 10
A: Speed of train relative to man = (60 + 6) km/hr = 66 km/hr
[convert km/hr to m/sec] = (66 * 5/18) m/sec = (55/3) m/sec
Time taken to pass the man = time taken to cover (110 m) at (55/3) m/sec
= (110 * 3/55) sec = 6 sec. The answer is (A).
